This is by far the best of all the Petco chains in our area! The staff have been with this store for at least 10 years, & that is so important for customers, knowing there is someone we know & trust to help us with our dogs & cats. The trainer there is exceptional in knowledge & compassion. Her classes are always full, with many going on to private training with her. There have been several managers, but the staff has stayed the same & I do hope Petco appreciates that! We as customers certainly do... Again, THE BEST PETCO STORE

Our dog April has been taking training classes with Brigitte Ortega. Brigitte is a wonderful Trainer. She is very knowledgeable and patient and all her canine students love her (so do their Parents). The other employees at this Store are friendly and provide great service. We will definitely be shopping at this Petco store in the future. (Unleashed by Petco, Granada Hills Store).

Showed up yesterday to get my pup his bday pup pie and found them on stock. Was so happy  because every else where not available. Sales rep showed me straight to what i needed and appreciated her help. Even went out her way to replace a snack my dog was allergic to, which was bacon. So instead got a banana peanut butter frozen  treat he loved. This is going to be my to go place now. Plenty of parking and employees are so generous to help out and greet you in and out the store. Didnt catch her name but wished i would have to put it here, i was in a rush. Recommend this spot. 🙏
